trust_decision.summary: Whether a file name derived from an index-supplied URL (path basename, netloc fallback, or Content-Disposition/redirect-extension) is a single path component before it is joined onto pip's download/temp directory; decided in Link.filename and _get_http_response_filename.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'doubly-encoded package URLs'; the second urllib.parse.unquote in Link.filename (path already unquoted once at link.py:265) is the obvious double decode.

fix_sites.entry_point: pip install / pip download / pip wheel / pip lock resolving a link from an index page (Link.from_element / Link.from_json)
pip install / download / wheel / lock via RequirementPreparer -> get_http_url -> Downloader.__call__ and Downloader.batch (prepare.py:121, prepare.py:477)
fix_sites.module_kind: network (HTTP downloader, Content-Disposition and redirect-extension handling)

fix_sites.entry_point: same as above; the open(filepath, 'wb') sink

pip download -d / pip wheel -w (download_dir set at commands/download.py:117, commands/wheel.py:123) via get_http_url/get_file_url (prepare.py:114, prepare.py:135); exists/hash-check/unlink at prepare.py:206-220
pip download / pip wheel save_linked_requirement (commands/download.py:140, commands/wheel.py:145); shutil.copy sink

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/pip/_internal/network/download.py:124-142 (_get_http_response_filename: Content-Disposition result and resp.url extension are composed with link.filename; fix validates the composed name with as_path_component, fix.diff:131-140)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Content-Disposition is already sanitised with os.path.basename (download.py:102-106) and has its own traversal test (tests/unit/test_operations_prepare.py:63-94), so once Link.filename stops double-decoding a solver can argue the downloader composition is already safe and needs no change — yet '..' survives basename and the redirect-extension append is never re-validated.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Link.filename must still decode exactly once: '%2B' -> '+' in local-version wheel names and '%23' -> '#' (tests/unit/test_link.py:31-33), and path-less URLs must still fall back to the netloc; an over-broad fix (no decoding, rejecting '%', or raising on empty/netloc names) breaks Wheel(link.filename) parsing in package_finder and the netloc fallback.

O6_input_shapes: double-encoded separator in URL path ('%252F' -> '/' after second unquote)
path that is only '.' or '..' (plain or single-encoded '%2e%2e') yielding basename '..'
path-less URL whose netloc is a traversal ('http://..\..\evil.whl', 'http://..'), netloc fallback
Content-Disposition filename reducing to '..' or empty

O7_producer.where: src/pip/_internal/models/link.py:265 and :436 (Link path decode + filename property feed every sink; Link objects built from index HTML/JSON at link.py:296, link.py:354)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: metadata-file (PEP 658) download saving '<filename>.metadata' into a cache dir using a name derived from metadata_link path rather than Link.filename
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: metadata_link builds a new URL by string append (link.py:504); a maintainer caching .metadata files next to downloads would naturally name them from the URL path.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: pylock install path that materialises wheels into a local dir named from PackageWheel.name (itself link.filename or a lock-file-provided name)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: pylock already records name=link.filename; a downloader honouring the recorded name is a plausible feature and a second producer the Link check never calls.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second decode of the Content-Disposition filename (RFC 5987 filename*= handling with unquote) after sanitize_content_filename
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Supporting filename*=UTF-8''... requires percent-decoding; doing it after basename recreates the same decode-after-check differential in another input source.

O9_family: path traversal via decode-after-check (double percent-decoding of URL-derived file name; CWE-36/CWE-22)

O10_build.toolchain: Python 3 + pytest (nox/tox config in repo); pure Python, vendored deps
O10_build.project_tests: tests/unit/test_link.py (TestLink.test_filename), tests/unit/test_network_download.py (sanitize/parse_content_disposition), tests/unit/test_operations_prepare.py (test_download_http_url__no_directory_traversal) — all mock HTTP, no network

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Delete the second urllib.parse.unquote in Link.filename (or basename after it) and stop, leaving '..'/'.' names, the netloc fallback and the Content-Disposition/redirect-extension composition in the downloader unvalidated.
